tools.name: save_ride
tools.description: Upsert one of the caller's rides as domain records (ride request plus its driver, vehicle, quote, assignment, trip, trip status event and transition history; trip status only moves forward). Idempotent: ids are derived from the client ride, so replaying the same ride changes nothing.
statements: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO riders (id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:__user_id, :__now, :__now)

INSERT INTO drivers (rider_id, id, display_name, rating, status, created_at, updated_at) SELECT :__user_id, :driver_id, :driver_name, :driver_rating, 'active', :__now, :__now WHERE :driver_id IS NOT NULL ON CONFLICT (rider_id, id) DO UPDATE SET display_name = excluded.display_name, rating = COALESCE(excluded.rating, drivers.rating), updated_at = excluded.updated_at

INSERT INTO vehicles (rider_id, id, driver_id, plate, vehicle_class, created_at, updated_at) SELECT :__user_id, :vehicle_id, :driver_id, :vehicle_plate, :vehicle_class, :__now, :__now WHERE :vehicle_id IS NOT NULL ON CONFLICT (rider_id, id) DO UPDATE SET driver_id = excluded.driver_id, vehicle_class = COALESCE(excluded.vehicle_class, vehicles.vehicle_class), updated_at = excluded.updated_at

INSERT INTO ride_requests (rider_id, id, booking_type, status, pickup_label, pickup_lat, pickup_lng, dropoff_label, dropoff_lat, dropoff_lng, recurring_days, pickup_time, scheduled_for, vehicle_class, requested_at, client_record, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:__user_id, :request_id, :booking_type, :request_status, :pickup_label, :pickup_lat, :pickup_lng, :dropoff_label, :dropoff_lat, :dropoff_lng, :recurring_days, :pickup_time, :scheduled_for, :vehicle_class, :requested_at, :client_record, :created_at, :__now) ON CONFLICT (rider_id, id) DO UPDATE SET booking_type = excluded.booking_type, status = CASE WHEN excluded.status = 'open' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dispatch_requests d WHERE d.rider_id = ride_requests.rider_id AND d.request_id = ride_requests.id AND d.status = 'matched') THEN 'matched' ELSE excluded.status END, pickup_label = excluded.pickup_label, pickup_lat = excluded.pickup_lat, pickup_lng = excluded.pickup_lng, dropoff_label = excluded.dropoff_label, dropoff_lat = excluded.dropoff_lat, dropoff_lng = excluded.dropoff_lng, recurring_days = excluded.recurring_days, pickup_time = excluded.pickup_time, scheduled_for = excluded.scheduled_for, vehicle_class = excluded.vehicle_class, requested_at = excluded.requested_at, client_record = excluded.client_record, updated_at = excluded.updated_at

INSERT INTO quotes (rider_id, id, request_id, vehicle_class, fare_cents, eta_minutes, status, created_at, updated_at) SELECT :__user_id, :quote_id, :request_id, :vehicle_class, :fare_cents, :eta_minutes, 'accepted', :__now, :__now WHERE :quote_id IS NOT NULL ON CONFLICT (rider_id, id) DO UPDATE SET vehicle_class = excluded.vehicle_class, fare_cents = excluded.fare_cents, eta_minutes = excluded.eta_minutes, updated_at = excluded.updated_at

INSERT INTO assignments (rider_id, id, request_id, driver_id, vehicle_id, status, created_at, updated_at) SELECT :__user_id, :assignment_id, :request_id, :driver_id, :vehicle_id, 'accepted', :__now, :__now WHERE :assignment_id IS NOT NULL ON CONFLICT (rider_id, id) DO UPDATE SET driver_id = excluded.driver_id, vehicle_id = excluded.vehicle_id, updated_at = excluded.updated_at

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO trip_transitions (rider_id, id, trip_id, from_status, to_status, actor_type, actor_id, metadata, at) SELECT :__user_id, :trip_event_id, :trip_id, CASE WHEN c.cur = :trip_status THEN NULL ELSE c.cur END, :trip_status, 'rider', :__user_id, '{"source":"save_ride"}', :__now FROM (SELECT (SELECT t.status FROM trips t WHERE t.rider_id = :__user_id AND t.id = :trip_id) AS cur) c WHERE :trip_event_id IS NOT NULL AND (c.cur IS NULL OR c.cur = :trip_status OR (c.cur IN ('scheduled', 'en_route', 'arrived') AND CASE :trip_status WHEN 'scheduled' THEN 0 WHEN 'en_route' THEN 1 WHEN 'arrived' THEN 2 WHEN 'completed' THEN 3 END > CASE c.cur WHEN 'scheduled' THEN 0 WHEN 'en_route' THEN 1 WHEN 'arrived' THEN 2 WHEN 'completed' THEN 3 END))

INSERT INTO trips (rider_id, id, request_id, assignment_id, status, created_at, updated_at) SELECT :__user_id, :trip_id, :request_id, :assignment_id, :trip_status, :__now, :__now WHERE :trip_id IS NOT NULL ON CONFLICT (rider_id, id) DO UPDATE SET assignment_id = excluded.assignment_id, status = CASE WHEN trips.status IN ('scheduled', 'en_route', 'arrived') AND CASE excluded.status WHEN 'scheduled' THEN 0 WHEN 'en_route' THEN 1 WHEN 'arrived' THEN 2 WHEN 'completed' THEN 3 END > CASE trips.status WHEN 'scheduled' THEN 0 WHEN 'en_route' THEN 1 WHEN 'arrived' THEN 2 WHEN 'completed' THEN 3 END THEN excluded.status ELSE trips.status END, updated_at = excluded.updated_at

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO trip_events (rider_id, id, trip_id, type, status, at) SELECT :__user_id, :trip_event_id, :trip_id, 'status', :trip_status, :__now WHERE :trip_event_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trips t WHERE t.rider_id = :__user_id AND t.id = :trip_id AND t.status = :trip_status)

tools.name: cancel_ride
tools.description: Rider: cancel one of the caller's ride requests. A matched trip is cancelled with a recorded reason (changed_plans, wait_too_long, wrong_pickup, found_other, other) and a fee under the cancellation policy: free before a driver is assigned and within 2 minutes of assignment, 5.00 later (capped at the fare), 8.00 once the driver has arrived. A trip that has started or finished cannot be cancelled by the rider; completed history is never rewritten. Withdraws any dispatch offer. Deletes the trip's live location. Finalizes the immutable fare statement for the trip.

(c.final * 10000 + 5000) / 10000, 0, (c.final * 0 + 5000) / 10000, c.final - (c.final - (c.final * 10000 + 5000) / 10000) - (c.final * 0 + 5000) / 10000, 'v0-unconfigured', c.outcome, c.pickup, c.dropoff, :__now FROM (SELECT t.rider_id AS rider_id, t.id AS trip_id, t.request_id AS request_id, (SELECT d.user_id FROM assignments a JOIN drivers d ON d.rider_id = a.rider_id AND d.id = a.driver_id WHERE a.rider_id = t.rider_id AND a.id = t.assignment_id) AS driver_user_id, l.outcome AS outcome, CASE WHEN l.outcome = 'completed' THEN 'fare' WHEN l.outcome = 'rider_no_show' AND l.cancel_fee_cents > 0 THEN 'no_show_fee' WHEN l.cancel_fee_cents > 0 THEN 'cancellation_fee' ELSE 'none' END AS basis, f.id AS quote_id, coalesce(f.total_cents, (SELECT q.fare_cents FROM quotes q WHERE q.rider_id = t.rider_id AND q.request_id = t.request_id), 0) AS quoted, f.base_cents AS base, f.distance_cents AS dist, f.time_cents AS tim, f.booking_fee_cents AS fee, f.min_adjust_cents AS adj, f.surge_milli AS surge, CASE WHEN l.outcome = 'completed' THEN coalesce(f.total_cents, (SELECT q.fare_cents FROM quotes q WHERE q.rider_id = t.rider_id AND q.request_id = t.request_id), 0) ELSE l.cancel_fee_cents END AS final, r.pickup_label AS pickup, r.dropoff_label AS dropoff FROM trips t JOIN trip_lifecycle l ON l.rider_id = t.rider_id AND l.trip_id = t.id JOIN ride_requests r ON r.rider_id = t.rider_id AND r.id = t.request_id LEFT JOIN fare_quotes f ON f.rider_id = t.rider_id AND f.ride_id = t.request_id AND f.status = 'accepted' WHERE t.rider_id = :__user_id AND t.request_id = :request_id AND t.status IN ('scheduled', 'en_route', 'arrived') AND (SELECT l.started_at FROM trip_lifecycle l WHERE l.rider_id = t.rider_id AND l.trip_id = t.id) IS NULL) c

tools.name: advance_trip
tools.description: Driver: move the assigned trip one step: scheduled -> en_route -> arrived, and arrived -> completed only after start_trip. Cancelling is a separate action (driver_cancel_trip). Invalid transitions, repeated requests, unassigned trips and other drivers' trips change nothing and write no audit row. Completing releases the driver's dispatch lock and completes the ride request. Completing deletes the trip's live location. Finalizes the immutable fare statement for the trip.

:trip_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM assignments a JOIN drivers d ON d.rider_id = a.rider_id AND d.id = a.driver_id WHERE a.rider_id = t.rider_id AND a.id = t.assignment_id AND d.user_id = :__user_id) tools.name: list_my_trips

tools.name: list_driver_trips

tools.name: get_driver_trip_history

tools.name: get_my_driver_application
tools.description: The caller's own driver application, status and the reason for the last decision (no row until started)
tools.sql: SELECT status, full_name, phone, licence_number, licence_region, licence_expires, eligibility_confirmed, status_reason, submitted_at, reviewed_at, updated_at FROM driver_applications WHERE user_id = :__user_id

tools.name: save_driver_application
tools.description: Create or edit the caller's driver application (profile, licence and eligibility). Only while it is a draft or was rejected; submitted, approved and suspended applications are locked. Licence details are private: visible only to the applicant and ops.
tools.sql: INSERT INTO driver_applications (user_id, status, full_name, phone, licence_number, licence_region, licence_expires, eligibility_confirmed, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:__user_id, 'draft', :full_name, :phone, :licence_number, :licence_region, :licence_expires, :eligibility_confirmed, :__now, :__now) ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET full_name = excluded.full_name, phone = excluded.phone, licence_number = excluded.licence_number, licence_region = excluded.licence_region, licence_expires = excluded.licence_expires, eligibility_confirmed = excluded.eligibility_confirmed, updated_at = excluded.updated_at WHERE driver_applications.status IN ('draft', 'rejected')

tools.name: list_my_driver_vehicles
tools.description: The caller's vehicles with their approval status and reason
tools.sql: SELECT id, plate, make, model, year, colour, seats, vehicle_class, status, status_reason FROM driver_vehicles WHERE user_id = :__user_id ORDER BY created_at

tools.name: save_driver_vehicle
tools.description: Add or edit one of the caller's vehicles. Changing any detail of an existing vehicle sends it back to pending review and takes the driver off dispatch if it was the active vehicle.
statements: INSERT INTO driver_vehicles (user_id, id, plate, make, model, year, colour, seats, vehicle_class, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:__user_id, :vehicle_id, :plate, :make, :model, :year, :colour, :seats, :vehicle_class, 'pending', :__now, :__now) ON CONFLICT (user_id, id) DO UPDATE SET status = CASE WHEN driver_vehicles.plate IS excluded.plate AND driver_vehicles.make IS excluded.make AND driver_vehicles.model IS excluded.model AND driver_vehicles.year IS excluded.year AND driver_vehicles.colour IS excluded.colour AND driver_vehicles.seats IS excluded.seats AND driver_vehicles.vehicle_class IS excluded.vehicle_class THEN driver_vehicles.status ELSE 'pending' END, plate = excluded.plate, make = excluded.make, model = excluded.model, year = excluded.year, colour = excluded.colour, seats = excluded.seats, vehicle_class = excluded.vehicle_class, updated_at = excluded.updated_at

UPDATE driver_availability SET available = 0, updated_at = :__now WHERE user_id = :__user_id AND vehicle_id = :vehicle_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM driver_vehicles v WHERE v.user_id = :__user_id AND v.id = :vehicle_id AND v.status = 'approved')

tools.name: delete_driver_vehicle
tools.description: Remove one of the caller's vehicles (and take the driver off dispatch if it was the active vehicle)

DELETE FROM driver_vehicles WHERE user_id = :__user_id AND id = :vehicle_id

tools.name: submit_driver_application
tools.description: Submit the caller's application for review. Needs name, phone, licence number/region/expiry, confirmed eligibility and at least one vehicle. Only from draft or rejected. Audited.
statements: INSERT INTO driver_review_log (id, user_id, vehicle_id, from_status, to_status, reason, actor_id, actor_role, at) SELECT :__uuid, a.user_id, NULL, a.status, 'submitted', NULL, :__user_id, 'applicant', :__now FROM driver_applications a WHERE a.user_id = :__user_id AND a.status IN ('draft', 'rejected') AND a.full_name IS NOT NULL AND trim(a.full_name) != '' AND a.phone IS NOT NULL AND trim(a.phone) != '' AND a.licence_number IS NOT NULL AND trim(a.licence_number) != '' AND a.licence_region IS NOT NULL AND trim(a.licence_region) != '' AND a.licence_expires IS NOT NULL AND trim(a.licence_expires) != '' AND a.eligibility_confirmed = 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM driver_vehicles v WHERE v.user_id = a.user_id)

UPDATE driver_applications SET status = 'submitted', status_reason = NULL, submitted_at = :__now, updated_at = :__now WHERE user_id = :__user_id AND status IN ('draft', 'rejected') AND full_name IS NOT NULL AND trim(full_name) != '' AND phone IS NOT NULL AND trim(phone) != '' AND licence_number IS NOT NULL AND trim(licence_number) != '' AND licence_region IS NOT NULL AND trim(licence_region) != '' AND licence_expires IS NOT NULL AND trim(licence_expires) != '' AND eligibility_confirmed = 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM driver_vehicles v WHERE v.user_id = driver_applications.user_id)

tools.name: list_my_driver_review_log
tools.description: The audit trail of decisions on the caller's application and vehicles, oldest first
tools.sql: SELECT vehicle_id, from_status, to_status, reason, actor_role, at FROM driver_review_log WHERE user_id = :__user_id ORDER BY at, rowid

tools.name: get_my_driver_availability
tools.description: Whether the caller is currently available for dispatch, and with which vehicle
tools.sql: SELECT available, vehicle_id, updated_at FROM driver_availability WHERE user_id = :__user_id

tools.name: set_driver_availability
tools.description: Go on or off dispatch. Going available only works for an approved (not suspended) driver with an unexpired licence and an approved vehicle; otherwise nothing changes. Going unavailable always works. Going offline also withdraws any open offer to the driver.
statements: INSERT INTO driver_availability (user_id, available, vehicle_id, updated_at) SELECT :__user_id, :available, :vehicle_id, :__now WHERE :available = 0 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM driver_applications a JOIN driver_vehicles v ON v.user_id = a.user_id WHERE a.user_id = :__user_id AND a.status = 'approved' AND a.licence_expires >= date(:__now / 1000, 'unixepoch') AND v.id = :vehicle_id AND v.status = 'approved') ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET available = excluded.available, vehicle_id = COALESCE(excluded.vehicle_id, driver_availability.vehicle_id), updated_at = excluded.updated_at
UPDATE dispatch_offers SET status = 'cancelled', responded_at = :__now WHERE driver_id = :__user_id AND status = 'offered' AND :available = 0

tools.name: list_driver_applications
tools.description: Ops: driver applications, oldest submission first, optionally by status. Licence number is masked to its last 4 characters. Excludes the caller's own application.
tools.sql: SELECT a.user_id, a.status, a.full_name, a.phone, substr(a.licence_number, -4) AS licence_last4, a.licence_region, a.licence_expires, a.submitted_at, a.updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM driver_vehicles v WHERE v.user_id = a.user_id) AS vehicle_count FROM driver_applications a WHERE a.user_id != :__user_id AND (:status IS NULL OR a.status = :status) ORDER BY a.submitted_at LIMIT :limit

tools.name: get_driver_application_detail
tools.description: Ops: one application in full, including the licence number, for verification
tools.sql: SELECT user_id, status, full_name, phone, licence_number, licence_region, licence_expires, eligibility_confirmed, status_reason, submitted_at, reviewed_at, reviewed_by FROM driver_applications WHERE user_id = :driver_user_id AND user_id != :__user_id

tools.name: list_driver_vehicles_for_review
tools.description: Ops: a driver's vehicles
tools.sql: SELECT id, plate, make, model, year, colour, seats, vehicle_class, status, status_reason FROM driver_vehicles WHERE user_id = :driver_user_id AND user_id != :__user_id ORDER BY created_at

tools.name: list_driver_review_log
tools.description: Ops: the audit trail for one driver (who decided what, when and why), oldest first
tools.sql: SELECT vehicle_id, from_status, to_status, reason, actor_id, actor_role, at FROM driver_review_log WHERE user_id = :driver_user_id AND user_id != :__user_id ORDER BY at, rowid

tools.name: review_driver_application
tools.description: Ops: decide an application. submitted -> approved|rejected, approved -> suspended, suspended -> approved. Rejecting and suspending need a reason. Approving from submitted also approves the driver's pending vehicles; rejecting or suspending takes the driver off dispatch. Cannot review your own application. Every decision is audited with actor and reason; an invalid move changes nothing.
statements: INSERT INTO driver_review_log (id, user_id, vehicle_id, from_status, to_status, reason, actor_id, actor_role, at) SELECT :__uuid, a.user_id, NULL, a.status, :decision, :reason, :__user_id, 'ops', :__now FROM driver_applications a WHERE a.user_id = :driver_user_id AND a.user_id != :__user_id AND ((a.status = 'submitted' AND :decision IN ('approved', 'rejected')) OR (a.status = 'approved' AND :decision = 'suspended') OR (a.status = 'suspended' AND :decision = 'approved')) AND (:decision = 'approved' OR length(trim(coalesce(:reason, ''))) > 0)

UPDATE driver_vehicles SET status = 'approved', status_reason = NULL, updated_at = :__now WHERE user_id = :driver_user_id AND status = 'pending' AND :decision = 'approved' AND :driver_user_id != :__user_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM driver_applications a WHERE a.user_id = :driver_user_id AND a.user_id != :__user_id AND ((a.status = 'submitted' AND :decision IN ('approved', 'rejected')) OR (a.status = 'approved' AND :decision = 'suspended') OR (a.status = 'suspended' AND :decision = 'approved')) AND (:decision = 'approved' OR length(trim(coalesce(:reason, ''))) > 0) AND a.status = 'submitted')

UPDATE driver_availability SET available = 0, updated_at = :__now WHERE user_id = :driver_user_id AND :decision IN ('rejected', 'suspended') AND :driver_user_id != :__user_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM driver_applications a WHERE a.user_id = :driver_user_id AND a.user_id != :__user_id AND ((a.status = 'submitted' AND :decision IN ('approved', 'rejected')) OR (a.status = 'approved' AND :decision = 'suspended') OR (a.status = 'suspended' AND :decision = 'approved')) AND (:decision = 'approved' OR length(trim(coalesce(:reason, ''))) > 0))

UPDATE driver_applications SET status = :decision, status_reason = CASE WHEN :decision = 'approved' THEN NULL ELSE trim(:reason) END, reviewed_at = :__now, reviewed_by = :__user_id, updated_at = :__now WHERE user_id = :driver_user_id AND user_id != :__user_id AND ((driver_applications.status = 'submitted' AND :decision IN ('approved', 'rejected')) OR (driver_applications.status = 'approved' AND :decision = 'suspended') OR (driver_applications.status = 'suspended' AND :decision = 'approved')) AND (:decision = 'approved' OR length(trim(coalesce(:reason, ''))) > 0)

tools.name: review_driver_vehicle
tools.description: Ops: approve or reject one vehicle (pending -> approved|rejected, approved -> rejected). Rejecting needs a reason and takes the driver off dispatch if it was their active vehicle. Audited.
statements: INSERT INTO driver_review_log (id, user_id, vehicle_id, from_status, to_status, reason, actor_id, actor_role, at) SELECT :__uuid, v.user_id, v.id, v.status, :decision, :reason, :__user_id, 'ops', :__now FROM driver_vehicles v WHERE v.user_id = :driver_user_id AND v.user_id != :__user_id AND v.id = :vehicle_id AND ((v.status = 'pending' AND :decision IN ('approved', 'rejected')) OR (v.status = 'approved' AND :decision = 'rejected')) AND (:decision = 'approved' OR length(trim(coalesce(:reason, ''))) > 0)

UPDATE driver_availability SET available = 0, updated_at = :__now WHERE user_id = :driver_user_id AND vehicle_id = :vehicle_id AND :decision = 'rejected' AND :driver_user_id != :__user_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM driver_vehicles v WHERE v.user_id = :driver_user_id AND v.id = :vehicle_id AND v.status IN ('pending', 'approved') AND length(trim(coalesce(:reason, ''))) > 0)

UPDATE driver_vehicles SET status = :decision, status_reason = CASE WHEN :decision = 'approved' THEN NULL ELSE trim(:reason) END, updated_at = :__now WHERE user_id = :driver_user_id AND user_id != :__user_id AND id = :vehicle_id AND ((status = 'pending' AND :decision IN ('approved', 'rejected')) OR (status = 'approved' AND :decision = 'rejected')) AND (:decision = 'approved' OR length(trim(coalesce(:reason, ''))) > 0)

tools.name: list_dispatchable_drivers
tools.description: Ops/dispatch: drivers who are available right now AND still approved, with an approved vehicle and an unexpired licence. Suspension, rejection or licence expiry removes a driver here even if their availability flag is stale.
tools.sql: SELECT d.user_id, a.full_name, v.id AS vehicle_id, v.plate, v.vehicle_class, v.seats FROM driver_availability d JOIN driver_applications a ON a.user_id = d.user_id JOIN driver_vehicles v ON v.user_id = d.user_id AND v.id = d.vehicle_id WHERE d.available = 1 AND a.status = 'approved' AND v.status = 'approved' AND a.licence_expires >= date(:__now / 1000, 'unixepoch') AND :__user_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY d.updated_at LIMIT :limit

tools.name: update_driver_location
tools.description: Driver: publish the caller's current position and the radius (0.5-50 km) they will serve around it. Only approved drivers; out-of-range values change nothing. Dispatch ignores locations older than 5 minutes, so keep publishing while online.
tools.sql: INSERT INTO driver_locations (user_id, lat, lng, service_radius_km, updated_at) SELECT :__user_id, :lat, :lng, :service_radius_km, :__now WHERE :lat BETWEEN -90 AND 90 AND :lng BETWEEN -180 AND 180 AND :service_radius_km BETWEEN 0.5 AND 50 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM driver_applications a WHERE a.user_id = :__user_id AND a.status = 'approved') ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET lat = excluded.lat, lng = excluded.lng, service_radius_km = excluded.service_radius_km, updated_at = excluded.updated_at

tools.name: get_my_driver_location
tools.description: The caller's last published position and service radius
tools.sql: SELECT lat, lng, service_radius_km, updated_at FROM driver_locations WHERE user_id = :__user_id

tools.name: list_my_offers
tools.description: Driver: the caller's live dispatch offer (unexpired) or accepted assignment, with pickup, drop-off and fare
tools.sql: SELECT o.rider_id, o.request_id, o.status, o.distance_km2, o.offered_at, o.expires_at, r.pickup_label, r.pickup_lat, r.pickup_lng, r.dropoff_label, r.vehicle_class, q.fare_cents FROM dispatch_offers o JOIN ride_requests r ON r.rider_id = o.rider_id AND r.id = o.request_id LEFT JOIN quotes q ON q.rider_id = o.rider_id AND q.request_id = o.request_id WHERE o.driver_id = :__user_id AND (o.status = 'accepted' OR (o.status = 'offered' AND o.expires_at > :__now)) ORDER BY o.offered_at

tools.name: accept_offer
tools.description: Driver: accept the caller's live offer. Atomic: succeeds only while the offer is unexpired, the request is still searching and the driver is still eligible and available. On success the rider gets an assignment and a scheduled trip, the request becomes matched, and the driver is linked to the trip so advance_trip works. Otherwise nothing changes.
statements: UPDATE dispatch_offers SET status = 'accepted', responded_at = :__now WHERE driver_id = :__user_id AND rider_id = :rider_id AND request_id = :request_id AND status = 'offered' AND expires_at > :__now AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM driver_availability da JOIN driver_applications a ON a.user_id = da.user_id JOIN driver_vehicles v ON v.user_id = da.user_id AND v.id = dispatch_offers.vehicle_id WHERE da.user_id = :__user_id AND da.available = 1 AND a.status = 'approved' AND a.licence_expires >= date(:__now / 1000, 'unixepoch') AND v.status = 'approved') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dispatch_requests dr WHERE dr.rider_id = :rider_id AND dr.request_id = :request_id AND dr.status = 'searching') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ride_requests r WHERE r.rider_id = :rider_id AND r.id = :request_id AND r.status = 'open')

tools.name: decline_offer

tools.name: request_dispatch
tools.description: Rider: start (or restart, after no_driver or cancel) driver search for one of the caller's open on-demand requests that has pickup coordinates. Save the ride first. Searching lasts 2 minutes and offers go to at most 3 drivers. Refused while the rider has another active on-demand request.

Idempotent: call it every few seconds until get_dispatch_status is matched, no_driver or cancelled.

tools.name: open_dispute
tools.description: Rider or assigned driver: dispute a completed or cancelled trip within 7 days. One dispute per participant per trip. Rider codes: overcharged, route, driver_conduct, cancel_fee, other. Driver codes: rider_conduct, cancel_fee, damage, other. Anyone else, other codes, repeats and open trips change nothing.
statements: INSERT INTO trip_lifecycle_events (rider_id, id, trip_id, event, actor_id, actor_role, reason_code, note, amount_cents, at) SELECT t.rider_id, :__uuid, t.id, 'dispute_opened', :__user_id, CASE WHEN t.rider_id = :__user_id THEN 'rider' ELSE 'driver' END, :reason_code, substr(trim(coalesce(:note, '')), 1, 200), NULL, :__now FROM trips t WHERE t.rider_id = :rider_id AND t.id = :trip_id AND t.status IN ('completed', 'cancelled') AND coalesce((SELECT l.ended_at FROM trip_lifecycle l WHERE l.rider_id = t.rider_id AND l.trip_id = t.id), t.updated_at) >= :__now - 604800000 AND (t.rider_id = :__user_id AND :reason_code IN ('overcharged', 'route', 'driver_conduct', 'cancel_fee', 'other') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM assignments a JOIN drivers d ON d.rider_id = a.rider_id AND d.id = a.driver_id WHERE a.rider_id = t.rider_id AND a.id = t.assignment_id AND d.user_id = :__user_id) AND :reason_code IN ('rider_conduct', 'cancel_fee', 'damage', 'other')) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trip_disputes x WHERE x.rider_id = t.rider_id AND x.trip_id = t.id AND x.opened_by = :__user_id)

tools.description: Ops: decide one open dispute (upheld or rejected) with a mandatory note; upholding may also waive the trip's cancellation fee. Audited. UPDATE trip_lifecycle SET cancel_fee_cents = 0, fee_policy = 'ops_waived', updated_at = :__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trips t WHERE t.rider_id = trip_lifecycle.rider_id AND t.id = trip_lifecycle.trip_id AND t.rider_id = :rider_id AND t.id = :trip_id AND t.rider_id != :__user_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM assignments a JOIN drivers d ON d.rider_id = a.rider_id AND d.id = a.driver_id WHERE a.rider_id = t.rider_id AND a.id = t.assignment_id AND d.user_id = :__user_id) AND :decision IN ('upheld', 'rejected') AND length(trim(coalesce(:note, ''))) > 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trip_disputes p WHERE p.rider_id = t.rider_id AND p.trip_id = t.id AND p.opened_by = :opened_by AND p.status = 'open') AND :decision = 'upheld' AND :waive_fee = 1 AND coalesce((SELECT l.cancel_fee_cents FROM trip_lifecycle l WHERE l.rider_id = t.rider_id AND l.trip_id = t.id), 0) > 0)

INSERT INTO trip_lifecycle_events (rider_id, id, trip_id, event, actor_id, actor_role, reason_code, note, amount_cents, at) SELECT t.rider_id, :__uuid, t.id, 'dispute_resolved', :__user_id, 'ops', :decision, substr(trim(coalesce(:note, '')), 1, 200), NULL, :__now FROM trips t WHERE t.rider_id = :rider_id AND t.id = :trip_id AND t.rider_id != :__user_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM assignments a JOIN drivers d ON d.rider_id = a.rider_id AND d.id = a.driver_id WHERE a.rider_id = t.rider_id AND a.id = t.assignment_id AND d.user_id = :__user_id) AND :decision IN ('upheld', 'rejected') AND length(trim(coalesce(:note, ''))) > 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trip_disputes p WHERE p.rider_id = t.rider_id AND p.trip_id = t.id AND p.opened_by = :opened_by AND p.status = 'open')

UPDATE trip_disputes SET status = 'resolved', decision = :decision, resolution_note = substr(trim(coalesce(:note, '')), 1, 200), resolved_by = :__user_id, resolved_at = :__now, fee_waived = CASE WHEN :decision = 'upheld' AND :waive_fee = 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trip_lifecycle l WHERE l.rider_id = trip_disputes.rider_id AND l.trip_id = trip_disputes.trip_id AND l.fee_policy = 'ops_waived') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END WHERE rider_id = :rider_id AND trip_id = :trip_id AND opened_by = :opened_by AND status = 'open' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trips t WHERE t.rider_id = :rider_id AND t.id = :trip_id AND t.rider_id != :__user_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM assignments a JOIN drivers d ON d.rider_id = a.rider_id AND d.id = a.driver_id WHERE a.rider_id = t.rider_id AND a.id = t.assignment_id AND d.user_id = :__user_id) AND :decision IN ('upheld', 'rejected') AND length(trim(coalesce(:note, ''))) > 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trip_disputes p WHERE p.rider_id = t.rider_id AND p.trip_id = t.id AND p.opened_by = :opened_by AND p.status = 'open'))

tools.name: get_my_trip_lifecycle
tools.description: Rider: the authoritative state of the caller's trip for a ride request: phase (scheduled, en_route, arrived, in_progress, completed, cancelled), who ended it and why, and any cancellation fee
tools.sql: SELECT t.id AS trip_id, t.request_id, t.status, CASE WHEN t.status = 'arrived' AND l.started_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'in_progress' ELSE t.status END AS phase, l.started_at, l.ended_at, l.outcome, l.cancelled_by_role, l.cancel_code, l.cancel_note, coalesce(l.cancel_fee_cents, 0) AS cancel_fee_cents, l.fee_policy, (SELECT MIN(x.at) FROM trip_transitions x WHERE x.rider_id = t.rider_id AND x.trip_id = t.id) AS assigned_at, t.updated_at, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trip_disputes p WHERE p.rider_id = t.rider_id AND p.trip_id = t.id AND p.opened_by = :__user_id) AS disputed FROM trips t LEFT JOIN trip_lifecycle l ON l.rider_id = t.rider_id AND l.trip_id = t.id WHERE t.rider_id = :__user_id AND t.request_id = :request_id

tools.name: get_driver_trip
tools.description: Driver: the authoritative state of a trip assigned to the caller, with pickup, drop-off and the time they arrived (for the rider no-show wait)
tools.sql: SELECT t.id AS trip_id, t.request_id, t.status, CASE WHEN t.status = 'arrived' AND l.started_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'in_progress' ELSE t.status END AS phase, l.started_at, l.ended_at, l.outcome, l.cancelled_by_role, l.cancel_code, l.cancel_note, coalesce(l.cancel_fee_cents, 0) AS cancel_fee_cents, l.fee_policy, (SELECT MIN(x.at) FROM trip_transitions x WHERE x.rider_id = t.rider_id AND x.trip_id = t.id) AS assigned_at, t.updated_at, r.pickup_label, r.pickup_lat, r.pickup_lng, r.dropoff_label, r.dropoff_lat, r.dropoff_lng, (SELECT MAX(x.at) FROM trip_transitions x WHERE x.rider_id = t.rider_id AND x.trip_id = t.id AND x.to_status = 'arrived') AS arrived_at, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trip_disputes p WHERE p.rider_id = t.rider_id AND p.trip_id = t.id AND p.opened_by = :__user_id) AS disputed FROM trips t JOIN ride_requests r ON r.rider_id = t.rider_id AND r.id = t.request_id LEFT JOIN trip_lifecycle l ON l.rider_id = t.rider_id AND l.trip_id = t.id WHERE t.rider_id = :rider_id AND t.id = :trip_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM assignments a JOIN drivers d ON d.rider_id = a.rider_id AND d.id = a.driver_id WHERE a.rider_id = t.rider_id AND a.id = t.assignment_id AND d.user_id = :__user_id)

tools.name: preview_cancellation
tools.description: Rider: what cancelling this ride would cost right now (fee_cents and policy). No row means no trip is assigned yet, so cancelling is free.
tools.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN t.status = 'arrived' THEN MIN(800, coalesce((SELECT q.fare_cents FROM quotes q WHERE q.rider_id = t.rider_id AND q.request_id = t.request_id), 0)) WHEN :__now - (SELECT MIN(x.at) FROM trip_transitions x WHERE x.rider_id = t.rider_id AND x.trip_id = t.id) <= 120000 THEN 0 ELSE MIN(500, coalesce((SELECT q.fare_cents FROM quotes q WHERE q.rider_id = t.rider_id AND q.request_id = t.request_id), 0)) END AS fee_cents, CASE WHEN t.status = 'arrived' THEN 'arrived_cancel' WHEN :__now - (SELECT MIN(x.at) FROM trip_transitions x WHERE x.rider_id = t.rider_id AND x.trip_id = t.id) <= 120000 THEN 'free_grace' ELSE 'late_cancel' END AS policy FROM trips t WHERE t.rider_id = :__user_id AND t.request_id = :request_id AND t.status IN ('scheduled', 'en_route', 'arrived') AND (SELECT l.started_at FROM trip_lifecycle l WHERE l.rider_id = t.rider_id AND l.trip_id = t.id) IS NULL

tools.name: list_my_trip_events
tools.description: Rider: lifecycle events (started, completed, cancelled, no_show, disputes) for the caller's trip, oldest first
tools.sql: SELECT event, actor_role, reason_code, note, amount_cents, at FROM trip_lifecycle_events WHERE rider_id = :__user_id AND trip_id = :trip_id ORDER BY at, rowid

tools.name: ops_get_trip_timeline
tools.description: Ops: a trip's full history, status transitions and lifecycle events interleaved by time. Cannot read trips the caller rides or drives.
tools.sql: SELECT kind, name, actor, detail, at FROM (SELECT 'transition' AS kind, x.to_status AS name, x.actor_type || ':' || x.actor_id AS actor, coalesce(x.metadata, '') AS detail, x.at AS at FROM trip_transitions x WHERE x.rider_id = :rider_id AND x.trip_id = :trip_id UNION ALL SELECT 'event', e.event, e.actor_role || ':' || e.actor_id, coalesce(e.reason_code, '') || ' ' || coalesce(e.note, ''), e.at FROM trip_lifecycle_events e WHERE e.rider_id = :rider_id AND e.trip_id = :trip_id) WHERE :rider_id != :__user_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trips t WHERE t.rider_id = :rider_id AND t.id = :trip_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM assignments a JOIN drivers d ON d.rider_id = a.rider_id AND d.id = a.driver_id WHERE a.rider_id = t.rider_id AND a.id = t.assignment_id AND d.user_id = :__user_id)) ORDER BY at

tools.name: publish_driver_location
tools.description: Driver: publish the assigned driver's position for a trip. Accepted only from the assigned driver while the trip is en_route or arrived (including in progress), never before they start driving or after the trip ends; at most one update per 3s (faster calls are dropped); implausible coordinates, accuracy (>500 m) or speed are dropped. Coordinates are rounded to 4 decimals (about 11 m) before storing. Only the latest position is kept, overwritten in place, and it is deleted when the trip ends; positions older than 24 hours are purged on every publish.
statements: DELETE FROM trip_locations WHERE updated_at < :__now - 86400000 AND :__user_id IS NOT NULL

INSERT INTO trip_locations (rider_id, trip_id, driver_id, lat, lng, accuracy_m, speed_mps, updated_at) SELECT t.rider_id, t.id, :__user_id, ROUND(:lat, 4), ROUND(:lng, 4), :accuracy_m, :speed_mps, :__now FROM trips t WHERE t.rider_id = :rider_id AND t.id = :trip_id AND t.status IN ('en_route', 'arrived') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM assignments a JOIN drivers d ON d.rider_id = a.rider_id AND d.id = a.driver_id WHERE a.rider_id = t.rider_id AND a.id = t.assignment_id AND d.user_id = :__user_id) AND :lat BETWEEN -90 AND 90 AND :lng BETWEEN -180 AND 180 AND coalesce(:accuracy_m, 0) BETWEEN 0 AND 500 AND coalesce(:speed_mps, 0) BETWEEN 0 AND 70 ON CONFLICT (rider_id, trip_id) DO UPDATE SET lat = excluded.lat, lng = excluded.lng, accuracy_m = excluded.accuracy_m, speed_mps = excluded.speed_mps, driver_id = excluded.driver_id, updated_at = excluded.updated_at WHERE :__now - trip_locations.updated_at >= 3000

tools.name: get_driver_location
tools.description: Rider: the assigned driver's latest position for the caller's own ride, with its age in milliseconds measured by the server clock. Returns a row only while the trip is en_route or arrived (including in progress); nothing before the driver starts driving or after the trip ends. The driver cannot read it, and no one else can.
tools.sql: SELECT l.lat, l.lng, l.accuracy_m, l.speed_mps, :__now - l.updated_at AS age_ms, t.status AS trip_status FROM trip_locations l JOIN trips t ON t.rider_id = l.rider_id AND t.id = l.trip_id WHERE l.rider_id = :__user_id AND t.request_id = :request_id AND t.status IN ('en_route', 'arrived')

tools.name: ops_credit_trip
tools.description: Ops: credit part or all of a finished trip's charge (reason goodwill, fare_error, duplicate_charge or other; a note is required). The immutable statement is untouched; a credit row is appended. The total credited can never exceed the statement's final amount, so a fare cannot be driven below zero or raised. request_key makes retries safe: repeating a key does nothing. Cannot be used on trips the caller rode or drove. No money moves; payment collection is not enabled.
tools.sql: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO fare_adjustments (rider_id, id, trip_id, kind, amount_cents, reason_code, note, actor_id, created_at) SELECT s.rider_id, :request_key, s.trip_id, 'credit', :amount_cents, :reason_code, substr(trim(:note), 1, 200), :__user_id, :__now FROM fare_statements s WHERE s.rider_id = :rider_id AND s.trip_id = :trip_id AND s.rider_id != :__user_id AND coalesce(s.driver_user_id, '') != :__user_id AND length(trim(coalesce(:request_key, ''))) > 0 AND length(trim(coalesce(:note, ''))) > 0 AND (:reason_code = 'goodwill' OR :reason_code = 'fare_error' OR :reason_code = 'duplicate_charge' OR :reason_code = 'other') AND :amount_cents > 0 AND :amount_cents <= s.final_cents - coalesce((SELECT SUM(x.amount_cents) FROM fare_adjustments x WHERE x.rider_id = s.rider_id AND x.trip_id = s.trip_id), 0)

tools.name: get_receipt
tools.description: Rider: the receipt for one of the caller's finished rides: the immutable statement (quote, fare components, fee or fare, tax) plus credits applied and the resulting total. Payment is not collected in the app yet, so this is a statement of what is owed, not proof of payment.
tools.sql: SELECT s.receipt_no, s.trip_id, s.request_id, s.basis, s.currency, s.outcome, s.quoted_cents, s.base_cents, s.distance_cents, s.time_cents, s.booking_fee_cents, s.min_adjust_cents, s.surge_milli, s.final_cents, s.tax_rate_bp, s.tax_cents, s.pickup_label, s.dropoff_label, s.finalized_at, coalesce((SELECT SUM(x.amount_cents) FROM fare_adjustments x WHERE x.rider_id = s.rider_id AND x.trip_id = s.trip_id), 0) AS credits_cents, s.final_cents - coalesce((SELECT SUM(x.amount_cents) FROM fare_adjustments x WHERE x.rider_id = s.rider_id AND x.trip_id = s.trip_id), 0) AS total_cents FROM fare_statements s WHERE s.rider_id = :__user_id AND s.request_id = :request_id

tools.name: list_my_receipts
tools.description: Rider: the caller's receipts, newest first
tools.sql: SELECT s.receipt_no, s.trip_id, s.request_id, s.basis, s.currency, s.outcome, s.quoted_cents, s.base_cents, s.distance_cents, s.time_cents, s.booking_fee_cents, s.min_adjust_cents, s.surge_milli, s.final_cents, s.tax_rate_bp, s.tax_cents, s.pickup_label, s.dropoff_label, s.finalized_at, coalesce((SELECT SUM(x.amount_cents) FROM fare_adjustments x WHERE x.rider_id = s.rider_id AND x.trip_id = s.trip_id), 0) AS credits_cents, s.final_cents - coalesce((SELECT SUM(x.amount_cents) FROM fare_adjustments x WHERE x.rider_id = s.rider_id AND x.trip_id = s.trip_id), 0) AS total_cents FROM fare_statements s WHERE s.rider_id = :__user_id ORDER BY s.finalized_at DESC LIMIT :limit

tools.name: list_receipt_adjustments
tools.description: Rider: credits applied to one of the caller's receipts, oldest first
tools.sql: SELECT id, kind, amount_cents, reason_code, note, created_at FROM fare_adjustments WHERE rider_id = :__user_id AND trip_id = :trip_id ORDER BY created_at, rowid

tools.name: list_my_earnings
tools.description: Driver: statements for trips the caller drove, newest first: the fare basis, the amount, tax, the platform fee and the driver's payout accrual under the policy in force when the trip ended. Accrual only; no payout is executed.
tools.sql: SELECT s.receipt_no, s.trip_id, s.basis, s.currency, s.final_cents, s.tax_cents, s.platform_fee_cents, s.driver_payout_cents, s.policy_version, s.outcome, s.finalized_at, coalesce((SELECT SUM(x.amount_cents) FROM fare_adjustments x WHERE x.rider_id = s.rider_id AND x.trip_id = s.trip_id), 0) AS credits_cents FROM fare_statements s WHERE s.driver_user_id = :__user_id ORDER BY s.finalized_at DESC LIMIT :limit

tools.name: ops_reconcile
tools.description: Ops: reconciliation of money records to trip data. Returns one row per problem (missing_statement, fare_not_quote, quote_changed, components_mismatch, fee_not_lifecycle, credits_exceed_final, refunds_without_payment, payout_mismatch, adjustment_without_statement); an empty result means every statement ties back to its trip, quote, and credits. Excludes trips the caller rode or drove.
tools.sql: SELECT r.rider_id, r.trip_id, r.code, r.detail FROM (SELECT t.rider_id AS rider_id, t.id AS trip_id, 'missing_statement' AS code, l.outcome AS detail FROM trips t JOIN trip_lifecycle l ON l.rider_id = t.rider_id AND l.trip_id = t.id WHERE t.status IN ('completed', 'cancelled') AND l.outcome IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fare_statements s WHERE s.rider_id = t.rider_id AND s.trip_id = t.id) UNION ALL SELECT s.rider_id AS rider_id, s.trip_id AS trip_id, 'fare_not_quote' AS code, s.final_cents || ' vs quoted ' || s.quoted_cents AS detail FROM fare_statements s WHERE s.basis = 'fare' AND s.final_cents != s.quoted_cents UNION ALL SELECT s.rider_id AS rider_id, s.trip_id AS trip_id, 'quote_changed' AS code, s.quoted_cents || ' vs now ' || q.fare_cents AS detail FROM fare_statements s JOIN quotes q ON q.rider_id = s.rider_id AND q.request_id = s.request_id WHERE s.quoted_cents != q.fare_cents UNION ALL SELECT s.rider_id AS rider_id, s.trip_id AS trip_id, 'components_mismatch' AS code, s.quoted_cents || ' vs ' || ((s.base_cents + s.distance_cents + s.time_cents + s.booking_fee_cents + s.min_adjust_cents) * s.surge_milli + 500) / 1000 AS detail FROM fare_statements s WHERE s.base_cents IS NOT NULL AND ((s.base_cents + s.distance_cents + s.time_cents + s.booking_fee_cents + s.min_adjust_cents) * s.surge_milli + 500) / 1000 != s.quoted_cents UNION ALL SELECT s.rider_id AS rider_id, s.trip_id AS trip_id, 'fee_not_lifecycle' AS code, s.final_cents || ' vs lifecycle ' || l.cancel_fee_cents AS detail FROM fare_statements s JOIN trip_lifecycle l ON l.rider_id = s.rider_id AND l.trip_id = s.trip_id WHERE s.basis != 'fare' AND s.final_cents != l.cancel_fee_cents + coalesce((SELECT SUM(x.amount_cents) FROM fare_adjustments x WHERE x.rider_id = s.rider_id AND x.trip_id = s.trip_id AND x.reason_code = 'dispute_waiver'), 0) UNION ALL SELECT s.rider_id AS rider_id, s.trip_id AS trip_id, 'credits_exceed_final' AS code, coalesce((SELECT SUM(x.amount_cents) FROM fare_adjustments x WHERE x.rider_id = s.rider_id AND x.trip_id = s.trip_id), 0) || ' vs ' || s.final_cents AS detail FROM fare_statements s WHERE coalesce((SELECT SUM(x.amount_cents) FROM fare_adjustments x WHERE x.rider_id = s.rider_id AND x.trip_id = s.trip_id), 0) > s.final_cents UNION ALL SELECT s.rider_id AS rider_id, s.trip_id AS trip_id, 'refunds_without_payment' AS code, 'no payment is recorded' AS detail FROM fare_statements s WHERE coalesce((SELECT SUM(x.amount_cents) FROM fare_adjustments x WHERE x.rider_id = s.rider_id AND x.trip_id = s.trip_id AND x.kind = 'refund'), 0) > 0 UNION ALL SELECT s.rider_id AS rider_id, s.trip_id AS trip_id, 'payout_mismatch' AS code, s.driver_payout_cents AS detail FROM fare_statements s WHERE s.final_cents - s.tax_cents - s.platform_fee_cents != s.driver_payout_cents UNION ALL SELECT x.rider_id AS rider_id, x.trip_id AS trip_id, 'adjustment_without_statement' AS code, x.id AS detail FROM fare_adjustments x WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fare_statements s WHERE s.rider_id = x.rider_id AND s.trip_id = x.trip_id)) r WHERE r.rider_id != :__user_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fare_statements s WHERE s.rider_id = r.rider_id AND s.trip_id = r.trip_id AND s.driver_user_id = :__user_id) ORDER BY r.rider_id, r.trip_id, r.code LIMIT :limit
